requirement: Keep each existing website design, photos, animation, navigation and complete page structure; translate full HTML pages, including archives, through a website translation tool.

recommendation.integration: paid translation proxy on language subdomains; no hosting-platform migration
recommendation.budget_assumption: Three separate subscriptions: USD 75/month before checkout taxes, exchange and card fees. Exact licensing/bill not verified in checkout.

inventory_scope: Read-only count from prior local source-aligned release trees. Excludes generated translated overview pages and redirect pages. Character count is not provider billable word count and is not a fresh live crawl.
implementation: Retain the original Japanese source and original CSS, images and JavaScript. Do not deploy the superseded overview pages.
Connect each approved source website to the paid translation proxy with per-language subdomains. Use actual Setup Wizard DNS targets only; never guess CNAME values.
Add a compact accessible language selector that preserves the current page path; reuse existing colors and typography. Do not route every selection to a reduced homepage.
Prevent translation of PACkage, OsakaPNG, yukuno, talent handles and product/game proper names. Use provider exclusions and human review for critical wording.
Check expansion/wrapping at 320,390,768,1440px; menu, animation, image loading, inner-page navigation, canonical/hreflang and 404 behavior.

Verify contact forms and security controls on translated hosts before activation. Do not send real submissions during unapproved tests. Image-embedded text and external documents require separate handling.
Show the actual provider-translated preview to the owner, then publish only after preview confirmation. No guarantee of pixel-perfect layout or translation quality before this test.
rollback: Remove or disable the new selector and translated-host routing via a reversible release. Original Japanese production and previous source commits remain available. No source history rewrite or deletion.

alternative.assessment: Cap applies across destination languages. Exact billed Japanese word count not measured. Full archives across four languages risk exceeding the cap; not selected merely on its starting price.

not_selected: Google Website Translator legacy widget: official notice says support ended 2026-10-01.
GTranslate free tier: official current page excludes commercial use.
approval_boundaries: New subscription/automatic renewal and account terms require owner approval. No service trial or account has been created.
New public translated hosts and public preview require owner approval; production follows actual preview review.
local_retention: Git trees and review copies retained pending revised tool integration and owner review; .keep-local present. No new full-site copy.
csb_capture: deferred; ongoing task, no verified tool integration outcome yet
